formation.name: earthly punishment black tortoise
formation.note: Dirty water penalty. Associated with disease, setbacks, and traps.
formation.desc: This is an unfavorable formation. Your plans will not succeed. Possible illness may arise. If meet with inauspicious doors, it denotes health hazard and prison term.

formation.name: green dragon elegant seal
formation.note: A neutral formation that is dependent on the auspiciousness of the doors.  This formation is related to enemies and rivals.
formation.desc: You can outwit your competitors, and your idea will bear fruitful results. Auspicious Doors in sight, this formation will bring good fortune. Without the presence of inauspicious Doors, however, this formation can cost you unusual setbacks and unpleasant affairs and or stagnant progress.

formation.name: stem combine snake punishment
formation.note: Flame meets grand Ocean. Neutral formation which indicates a mix of indecision and hesitation. Associated with lack of communication. Favors male.
formation.desc: There are a lot of confusions. Lack of clarity is the cause for the lack of progress in this case. Take time to communicate clearly and clear the air. The situation favors male more than female.

formation.name: small snake dragon force
formation.note: Mountain earth dams water. Associated with positive success, popularity, and fame. Unhindered progress.
formation.desc: The situation favors those who seek fame and reputation. There will be support for your work. Plans will be executed smoothly with little or no hiccup.

formation.name: stem combine rebelling officer
formation.note: Bing Wonder arrives to save the day. On appearance, the situation is worsened. In reality, the situation is controlled. Most optimal with Auspicious Door.
formation.desc: The situation may be bad, but it’s under control. Whether its outcome is favorable or not depends on the presence or absence of an Auspicious Door.

formation.name: bright sun and moon
formation.note: Sun shines on Flower. Wonders gather together to move plans forward.
formation.desc: Both official and personal affairs are well. All you need is better self control. You can execute your plans now.

formation.name: punishment structure
formation.note: Associated with disagreements, conflicts, legal problems. Advised to prepare for attacks and instability.
formation.desc: This formation denotes internal arguments, family dispute, debauchery, and lawsuit. Extremely undesirable.

formation.name: great yi hidden palace
formation.note: Iron covers Tree. Indicates darkness arising out of light. A turn from positive to negative. Associated with loss.
formation.desc: This is a highly inauspicious configuration. Denotes a switch from good to bad in a situation, loss of wealth and separation of loved ones.

formation.name: hour structure
formation.note: Fire meets Iron, conflict arises.  Blockages and setbacks reveal themselves.  Associated to obstruction in travel, communication, transmission, and plans.
formation.desc: This formation is also known as Jade Maiden Punishment Sha玉女刑殺 Geng 庚 is the Deity of Obstruction, so travelers might not be able to carry on their journey because of blocked communication or obstructed path in travelling. Document and communication are blocked; while events and situations develop inconsistently.

formation.name: leader flying palace
formation.note: Metal cut down roots. Associated with unexpected disasters, loss of direction, unsteady pace. Associated with worsening profits and health.
formation.desc: As the Lead Star, Jia 甲 is most vulnerable to the clash from Geng 庚 Metal. As such, this formation is named Leader Flying Palace 值符飛宮. It denotes derailing of plans and worsening situations, both due to the unforeseen or uncontrollable circumstances around. If situation were already bad, expect it to get worse. There is unlikely to be any profit from pursuit of business and even for health matters, and this negative streak follows when you’re seeking medication from doctor. This formation also indicates a change of place. Even with auspicious Door, this formation will not turn for good, and things would worsen if it meets with inauspicious Door. All previous efforts will be in vain.

formation.name: elegant seal receive grace
formation.note: Negative formation indicating downturn before upside. As situation progresses, matters will turn into positive light. One is advised to be careful with surrounding people, as they could be driven by deviated intentions.
formation.desc: There will be losses before your gain. You could be surrounded by malicious people with ill intent. But the outcome is still favorable as long as you can persevere. This formation is not auspicious for predicting illness.

formation.name: day noble enters earth
formation.note: Revolution is on the horizon.  Conflict between the fresh and the old.  Rebellions between the student and the master.  Advisable to hold situation with steady hands.
formation.desc: Young might rebel against the old, servants turn against their master, and one might be dragged into a messy tangle of lawsuit and constant troubles. Advisable to stick to the tried-and-tested rules as it is not favourable for taking shortcuts or risk. When meet with negative Doors, Stars and Deities, the situation may worsen as life-threatening dangers can be expected.

formation.name: small snake day noble
formation.note: Ocean water drowns Yi Wonder. Situation worsens with obstacles and flaws. Associated with a pressing force holding down progress, rumors, lies, and loss of faith.
formation.desc: This formation denotes drawbacks and obstructions. Nothing is going on smoothly and plans are flawed. Sometime is tying you down and holding you back. Denotes bickering and betrayal.

formation.name: flying bird fall into cave
formation.note: Earth reflects Sun, returning to Tree.  Great outlook for success, advancement, and promotion.
formation.desc: Same as Bing 丙 – Jia 甲 combo. Perfect resolution for most matters and you’re likely to achieve both fame and wealth.

formation.name: sun moon meeting
formation.note: Sun reveals Gold. Positive formation associated with uninterrupted progress, aid, and allies.
formation.desc: It represents positive outcome stemming from sound strategy. A good medical personnel will appear to cure your illness.

formation.name: fire enters grappling hook
formation.note: Fire and Ash become one.  Associated with a third party interrupting progress. Advised to be cautious of external influences.
formation.desc: Negative love luck that said to involve a third party in the form of a female. As such, be mindful of treachery and deceit in relationship.

formation.name: green dragon salivating the pearl
formation.note: Fire lights the way.  Associated with positive future and hopeful returns.
formation.desc: Denotes a promotion and a bright future ahead. Possible increase in salary and income. A positive formation indicating auspicious outcomes.

formation.name: bright hall hidden
formation.note: Iron from below. Brings conflict and disagreements. Resources will be targeted. Reputation will be at stake. Haste is not recommended.
formation.desc: This formation indicates upcoming legal disputes and arguments. Wealth may be lost and your privacy might be intruded. Be careful of being framed. Best to keep a low profile and stay passive. Do not initiate the lawsuit.

formation.name: leader flying palace
formation.note: Emotional distress as progress may reverse course.  Competition arises and seek to counter your objectives.
formation.desc: Auspicious matters turning the other way round, and continue to disintegrate. The situation is growing murkier and you are left feeling helpless. You seem to meet with rivals or challengers everywhere, and your feeling of fear and anxiety only attest to this inauspicious stride.

formation.name: heaven web end prison
formation.note: Water and Water cover the situation. One of the most unfavorable formations. Similar to a Punishment. Associated with trouble and chaos even amidst proper action. Lack of faith, trust, loyalty, and relationship control.
formation.desc: A highly inauspicious formation, where almost nothing is favorable. In fact you may get into trouble just for trying to help others. Marriage may turn sour and relationships become bitter. You may feel stuck as you juggle the lack of trust, commitment and love in your life.

formation.name: green dragon elegant seal
formation.note: Rainwater falls on Green Dragon Tree. Neutral formation. Meeting Auspicious Door signals joy and satisfaction.  Meeting Inauspicious Door signals disappointment.  Associated with education and academics.
formation.desc: As Jia 甲 is the Green Dragon 青龍 and Gui 癸 is the Heavenly Net or the Elegant Seal 華蓋, this formation is named as Green Dragon Elegant Seal 青龍 華蓋. The formation is neutral unless it is activated by an auspicious Door. It will then denote blessings and happiness. Favorable for scholarly pursuits.

formation.name: heavenly prison elegant seal
formation.note: Energies of sun and moon stagnate. Progress is bold and optimistic, but reality is setback and slow to improve.
formation.desc: As Xin 辛 is the Heavenly Prison 天牢 and Gui 癸 is the Elegant Seal 華蓋, this formation is named Heavenly Prison Elegant Seal 天牢華蓋. The Sun and Moon grow dim, trapped in the Heavenly Net by mistake. This shows that even though your intentions are pure and your dreams are big, there are forces beyond your control holding you back. Better not be unreasonable at this point. Moving forward is tough and you will be plagued by many obstacles.

formation.name: noble assisting jade maiden
formation.note: Positive for entering into new relationships and partnerships.  Wonder assists Jade Lady to carry out plans.  Execution in career-related situations shall be effective.
formation.desc: Good for signing contract or deals, Noble Assisting denotes well received ideas and strategy that will be executed effectively and that everything goes well. Very good for carrying out administrative work and examination.

formation.name: great white enters shimmer
formation.note: Metal conflicts fire. Associated with loss, reputation damage, operational obstruction. Emotional distress, anxiety, and uncertainty. Advised to take action rather than stay passive.  This formation favors guest.
formation.desc: Denotes loss of wealth, possibility of being framed or harmed, and orders not carried out efficiently. The situation tortures the mind, body and soul. It favours the guest, not the host. Hence it’s best to be proactive than reactive.

formation.name: spirit enters grave
formation.note: Surface does not match that which is below. Appearance seems positive.  Reality is less so.
formation.desc: The formation denotes that things are well on the surface, but going nowhere. It indicates being flashy with no substance. Because of greed, you may lose the big picture.

formation.name: green dragon broken feet
formation.note: The great dragon loses its roots.  Generallly inauspicious, but can be nullified with auspicious doors. One should pay attention to the foundation of the matter.
formation.desc: Denotes cutting away your foundation or removing your support. It is only with auspicious Doors you can make plans to escape or avoid a confrontation with your enemies. Meet with negative Doors, however, one may incur major cut-backs and loss of fortune. Also, be aware of injuries relating to your feet.

formation.name: shimmering enters great white
formation.note: Sun reveals Iron.  Inauspicious formation indicating stress in relationships related to possessions and ownership.
formation.desc: Highly unfavorable formation. It denotes crumbling family ties or relationships. Loss of belongings or ownership, including possible loss of wealth are imminent.

formation.name: bright sun and moon
formation.note: Sun shines on Flower. Wonders gather together to move plans forward.
formation.desc: Both official and personal affairs are well. All you need is better self control. You can execute your plans now.

formation.note: Ocean snake captured by Earth. Obstruction and blockages in the upcoming path. Goals should be diverted for safety and passivity.
formation.desc: This is a negative formation that implies many obstacles and obstruction ahead. Success is far-fetched. It also represents being framed or put in a situation to solve another person’s problems.

formation.name: green dragon enters prison
formation.note: Tree trapped under water. Indicates troubles from inside and outside. Associated with gossip, false truths, lies, and entangelements. Advised to stay out of chaos.
formation.desc: This formation indicates challenges from both domestic and foreign threats. You may be dragged into gossips and be the subject of rumors. Avoid trouble and hassle by staying passive and not getting involved.

formation.name: sitting palace structure
formation.note: Iron from above stabalizes below. A negative formation indicating initial failure prior to success.
formation.desc: You need to fail before you can succeed. This situation denotes that matters will first need to worsen before you see signs of improvement.

formation.name: noble enters heavenly door
formation.note: Inauspicious for Male. Auspicious for Female. Positive for concealed planning and strategizing.  Working behind the scenes will be enhanced with auspicious Doors.  Inauspicious Doors may result in obstruction, loss, or delay.  Associated with efficient rejuvenation, recovery, and leisure.
formation.desc: Favors female. Male counterpart that opts for this formation should be wary as it is inauspicious for them. Beneficial for scheming and initiating a stealth plan. Whenever auspicious Door is present within this formation, you can execute your plans effectively. With an inauspicious Door, however, brace yourself for wealth loss or bodily harm. This formation is good for meditating, embarking on a leisure travel and getting married.

formation.name: elegant seal rebelling officer
formation.note: Gui Water meets Bing Fire. A neutral formation indicating pleasant progress, although a bit slow. Positive outcomes will flourish, but patience and steadiness is required. Associated with seeking spiritual guidance.
formation.desc: Better stick to the present or tolerate with what you have at hand rather than going beyond the line and pursuing something that is out of your reach. Things will develop slowly and sluggishly. Patience is necessary. Not auspicious either for meeting or asking for favors from another. Except only if you are seeking refuge or wisdom from monk, priest or a spiritual person.

formation.name: restricted white tiger
formation.note: Ding Wonder suppresses Xin Metal. A neutral formation. Possible gains if in the presence of an Auspicious Door.
formation.desc: The Ding 丁 Fire controls the Xin 辛 Metal. This denotes a solution to the problem. Doing business will generate considerable profit and even if you are at wrong, you can get absolved from the guilt. With the absense of an auspicious door, everything will start off well but ends badly.

formation.name: the grand heavens meet prison
formation.note: Grand ocean suppresses progress. Personal conflicts with others. Obstructions throughout the process.
formation.desc: An unfavorable formation which denotes drawbacks, ill feelings, health hazards and confusion. Too many obstacles plague the way forward. Best to re look your plans.

formation.name: green dragon escape
formation.note: Yi Wonder (Green Dragon) meets White Tiger (Xin). This formation suggests separation of Yi and Xin.  Wife may leave husband.  Subordinates may leave superiors.  Those under control may detach from existing bonds.

formation.desc: The situation is unstable. Change is bound to happen for the worst. All efforts are futile as there are disagreements and miscommunications. Talents will remain unrecognized.

formation.name: enter prison self punishment
formation.note: Xin Metal rebels. Indicates betrayal of apprentice and master. The subordinate goes against the wills of the superior. Righteousness and justice not observed. Advised to be careful with surrounding allies.
formation.desc: As Xin 辛 is the sinner and Xu 戌 is the Grave of Wu Fire this formation is named Enter Prison Self Punishment 入獄自刑. It denotes servant turning against the master, and subordinate challenging the superior. Justice is not served from losing a lawsuit. Take note at work as betrayal, injustice abound.

formation.name: green dragon combines spirit
formation.note: Flower climbs on Mountain. Indication of climbing, steady progress.  Associated with positive returns and profitable endeavors.
formation.desc: A Wu 戊 - Yi 乙 combo. Jia 甲 and Yi 乙 meet at the East, which is the residence of the Green Dragon 青 龍. Hence the term Green Dragon Combines Spirit 青 龍合靈. Highly favorable outcome for making progress and executing plans. It also denotes positive returns on your money. If meet with auspicious Doors, its positive effect would be doubled. But if meet with inauspicious Doors, the positive effects would be nullified.

formation.name: heavenly yi combine
formation.note: Heavenly Mountain marries Rain. Positive formation suitable for marriages, relationships, and meeting others. A sign of harmony and joy.  Associated with noble help, support from allies, and happy gatherings.
formation.desc: Good for wealth and relationship matters. This formation promotes harmony and success. There will also be support from a Noble person. It also denotes good union.
